about: Pages 2 and 3 of a 24-hour ABPM report as the phone's recogniser returned them: the single readings and the averages by activity level. Geometry, cells and recogniser quirks are the real pages'; every reading, time, count and identifier is invented. Coordinates are normalised, y counts up from the bottom.
